description: Reads where a project's buyers are, as Market shows it: the communities they gather in (with their rules), live conversations worth joining (with Marsell's drafted reply), questions asked again and again, and the rivals with their prices. The rest of Market (creators, answers in AI assistants, listings, mentions) is what its agents found: agent_open, or place_open with market. The same findings with who buyers are and the rule for each community are discovery_read; setting one aside is set_aside.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

name: get_market
title: Get where the buyers are
